lead: Made for your maternity photos: an off-the-shoulder gown with big puffed organza sleeves, a gathered high waist that sits above the bump and a long, floaty, shimmering skirt that drifts into a short train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 10 days, so please allow about 22-26 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
off-the-shoulder puffed sleeves gathered at the upper arms, gathered high waist, and a long sheer A-line skirt with a short train.
pearlescent organza, 95% or more polyester. The gown is fully sheer, so plan to wear your own slip or lingerie underneath.
US 4, US 8, US 12 and US 16. Compare your bust and waist with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam gently from a distance to remove creases.
